examples.description: Poll for reminders that are due now

preconditions: Returns only notes whose triggers_at is set and has passed (triggers_at <= now); set a reminder via sticky_note_update with triggers_at (epoch ms).
Poll this, fire your local notification, then call sticky_note_dismiss with the note id so it stops being due.

description: Read this tenant's sticky notes whose reminder time (triggers_at) has arrived — the poll the desktop host runs to know what to fire as a local notification, since the web itself has no send channel. Read-only, no arguments: now is always the server's clock, never a caller-supplied value, and only notes with triggers_at set and <= now come back, soonest-due first, capped at 200. NEXT: sticky_note_dismiss clears triggers_at once you've notified, so the same note stops showing up here.
name: sticky_note_due
